main.q: What is on the Schnitz menu in Australia in 2026?
main.a: The Schnitz menu is built around hand-crumbed schnitzels in chicken, beef and plant-based versions. You can have them as wraps, burgers, plates with chips, salads, tenders and kids meals, plus chips, dips and drinks.

main.q: How much does Schnitz cost in Australia?
main.a: Most wraps and burgers cost around $14 to $17 (approx.), and schnitzel plates with chips sit around $19.50 to $25.50 (approx.). Prices vary between stores and are usually higher on delivery apps.

main.q: Does Schnitz have a gluten free menu?
main.a: Traditional crumbed schnitzels contain gluten, so they are not gluten free. Schnitz lists a gluten free wrap option on its allergen chart. If you have coeliac disease, talk to staff before ordering because cross-contact is possible in a busy kitchen.

main.q: What allergens are in a Schnitz schnitzel?
main.a: The chicken itself is listed with no allergens. The traditional crumbs contain wheat, gluten, egg, milk, soy and sesame. Always check the official Schnitz allergen chart for the crumb and sauces you choose.

main.q: What is the healthiest item at Schnitz?
main.a: A salad topped with schnitzel or a small serve of tenders is usually lighter than a plate with chips. Skipping the chips and creamy sauces is the easiest way to cut calories.

main.q: How many calories are in a Schnitz schnitzel and chips?
main.a: Third-party nutrition databases list Schnitzel & Chips at about 779 kcal and Parma & Chips at about 897 kcal. Treat these as estimates - the official figures may differ.

main.q: Does Schnitz have a kids menu?
main.a: Yes. The Little Rascals kids menu includes the Kiddy Schnugget Pack (around $11) and the Teeny Weeny, a small burger or wrap with mini chips and a Pop Top.
Most stores open from around 10:30 or 11am until about 9pm, but hours change by location, public holidays and shopping-centre trading hours. Check your local store before you go.

main.q: Can I order Schnitz on Menulog, Uber Eats or DoorDash?
main.a: Yes, many Schnitz stores are listed on delivery apps such as Uber Eats and DoorDash. Delivery menu prices are often higher than in-store pickup prices.

main.q: Is Schnitz halal certified in Australia?
main.a: Halal status can differ by supplier and by store, and we have not been able to confirm a national certification. Ask your local Schnitz store directly before ordering.

main.q: Does Schnitz have vegan or plant-based options?
main.a: Schnitz offers a plant-based schnitzel in many of its wraps and burgers. Plant-based does not always mean vegan, because crumbs and sauces can contain egg or milk - check the allergen chart.

main.q: What is the cheapest item on the Schnitz menu?
main.a: Dips (about $2) and small snacks such as 3 Tenders (about $7.90) are the cheapest items. For a full meal, look out for value deals that bundle a wrap, mini chips and a drink.

main.q: Does Schnitz have a rewards app?
main.a: Schnitz runs online ordering and app-based promotions from time to time. Check the official Schnitz website or app store for the current rewards program.

main.q: How do I find the nearest Schnitz?
main.a: Use the store locator on the official Schnitz website or search 'Schnitz near me' in Google Maps. Schnitz has stores across Victoria, New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia and more.

main.q: Does Schnitz change its menu seasonally?
main.a: Yes. Schnitz regularly runs limited-time menu items and deals, such as special burgers and family bundles. We update this guide every month to include new items.
